decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the firm's core postpress know-how, so its service technicians and application expertise let it read early results and refine the product.

UV spot varnishing is further from the firm's knowledge base, but the Duplo partnership supplies the technology and the high-profile German premiere signals commitment, so it stays despite weaker absorptive fit.
The sheet preparation module extends the existing modular systems, so the firm can assimilate feedback and integrate it into its automated workflows.
The B2 multifinisher builds directly on the firm's multifinishing expertise and was featured on the home page as a strategic launch, which makes it a strong keeper.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits squarely within the firm's booklet-making competence, so it can interpret results and improve the product with existing knowledge.
The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and already shows a documented customer installation, which provides learning feedback and justifies keeping it.
